newsitem.title: USA: United Dominion buys 3 apartment complexes.
newsitem.headline: United Dominion buys 3 apartment complexes.

text.p: United Dominion Realty Trust Inc said on Friday that it acquired three apartment communities with a total of 764 apartments, in two separate transactions.
United said it acquired for $4.7 million a newly built, 100-unit complex next to another property it already owned Greensboro, N.C.
The company said it also purchased two garden apartment communities totaling 664 units in Houston, both built in the mid-1980s, for an undisclosed price.
United Dominion also said it sold two complexes, a 156-unit community in Richmond and a 122-unit complex in Spartanburg, S.C.
The purchase price for the Houston properties was not disclosed.
The Richmond complex was sold for $4.1 million to the Clifford Housing Partnership LP. The Spartanburg complex went for $2.0 million, to Southwood Realty Co.
United Dominion now owns 59,000 apartments in 218 communities.
